capabilities: Strip metadata automatically from supported files when they enter the vault
Strip metadata manually via the right-click context menu
Bulk strip metadata from all existing vault files
Toggle stripping per format (JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF)
Preserve ICC color profiles to keep colors accurate
extras: The README warns that metadata removal is permanent and cannot be undone, and states all processing is local with no external services.
problem: Photos and documents added to a vault can carry embedded metadata (location, author, software) that leaks private information when notes are shared or published.
summary: Privacy plugin that automatically strips EXIF, IPTC, XMP and other metadata from images and PDFs when they are added to the vault.
